name: Kevin O'Connell's Boot & Dagger Play-Action System
description: A play-action ecosystem where every call wears the same uniform: a condensed gun formation that gives every call nearly the same wide-zone reach wash and mesh point for the first full second of every snap. The stretch base establishes the picture, the boot flood punishes flow-away defenders, the Dagger seam-curl attacks the dropping Mike, and the duo PA crosser exploits downhill triggers — four answers off one visual lie.
